package client_test

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	client "example.com/repo"
	"example.com/repo/local"
	"github.com/DonaldMurillo/gofastr/battery/auth"
	"github.com/DonaldMurillo/gofastr/core/handler"
	"github.com/DonaldMurillo/gofastr/core/schema"
	"github.com/DonaldMurillo/gofastr/framework"
	"github.com/DonaldMurillo/gofastr/framework/access"
	"github.com/DonaldMurillo/gofastr/framework/hook"
	"github.com/DonaldMurillo/gofastr/framework/owner"
	"github.com/DonaldMurillo/gofastr/framework/tenant"
	_ "github.com/DonaldMurillo/gofastr/sqlite/stdlib"
)

type identity struct{ id string }

func (user identity) GetID() string { return user.id }

type writeValue struct {
	Title string `json:"title"`
	Body  string `json:"body"`
}

func pointer[Value any](value Value) *Value { return &value }

func TestRepositoryParity(t *testing.T) {
	database, err := sql.Open("sqlite3", ":memory:")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer database.Close()
	database.SetMaxOpenConns(1)
	if _, err := database.Exec(`CREATE TABLE notes (
		id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		title TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT, score INTEGER DEFAULT 0
	)`); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	previous := owner.GetExtractor()
	owner.SetExtractor(func(ctx context.Context) (any, bool) {
		user, ok := handler.GetUser(ctx)
		if !ok {
			return nil, false
		}
		identity, ok := user.(identity)
		return identity.id, ok
	})
	defer owner.SetExtractor(previous)
	policy := access.NewRolePolicy()
	if err := policy.Grant("member", "notes:use"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	authenticate := func(ctx context.Context, token string) context.Context {
		if token == "" {
			return ctx
		}
		userID, tenantID := token, "one"
		if token == "alice-two" {
			userID, tenantID = "alice", "two"
		}
		ctx = handler.SetUser(ctx, identity{id: userID})
		ctx = tenant.SetTenantID(ctx, tenantID)
		ctx = access.WithPolicy(ctx, policy)
		if token != "denied" {
			ctx = access.WithRoles(ctx, []string{"member"})
		}
		return ctx
	}
	application := framework.NewApp(framework.WithDB(database), framework.WithConfig(framework.AppConfig{APIPrefix: "api"}))
	manager := auth.New(auth.AuthConfig{DevMode: true, UserStore: auth.NewEntityUserStore(database, "users")})
	application.Use(auth.SessionMiddleware(manager))
	application.Use(auth.CSRF())
	application.Use(func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
		return http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
			ctx := request.Context()
			if token := strings.TrimPrefix(request.Header.Get("Authorization"), "Bearer "); token != "" {
				ctx = authenticate(ctx, token)
			}
			next.ServeHTTP(writer, request.WithContext(ctx))
		})
	})
	application.Entity("notes", framework.EntityConfig{
		Fields: []schema.Field{
			{Name: "title", Type: schema.String, Required: true},
			{Name: "body", Type: schema.String, NoQuery: true},
			{Name: "score", Type: schema.Int},
			{Name: "owner_id", Type: schema.String, Hidden: true},
		},
		Scope: &framework.ScopeConfig{OwnerField: "owner_id", MultiTenant: true},
		Exposure: &framework.ExposureConfig{CRUD: pointer(true), Access: framework.AccessControl{
			Read: "notes:use", Create: "notes:use", Update: "notes:use", Delete: "notes:use",
		}},
	}.WithTimestamps(false))
	created, updated, deleted := 0, 0, 0
	framework.OnBeforeCreate(application, "notes", func(ctx context.Context, value *writeValue) error {
		if value.Title != "" {
			value.Title += "-created"
		}
		return nil
	})
	framework.OnAfterCreate(application, "notes", func(ctx context.Context, value *writeValue) error {
		created++
		return nil
	})
	framework.OnAfterUpdate(application, "notes", func(ctx context.Context, value *writeValue) error {
		updated++
		return nil
	})
	framework.OnAfterDelete(application, "notes", func(ctx context.Context, id string) error {
		deleted++
		return nil
	})
	framework.OnBeforeList(application, "notes", func(ctx context.Context, payload *hook.ListPayload) error {
		payload.AddWhere("title <> $1", "blocked-created")
		return nil
	})
	framework.OnBeforeGet(application, "notes", func(ctx context.Context, payload *hook.GetPayload) error {
		payload.AddWhere("title <> $1", "blocked-created")
		return nil
	})
	framework.OnAfterList(application, "notes", func(ctx context.Context, payload *hook.ListPayload) error {
		for _, row := range payload.Results {
			row["body"] = "masked"
		}
		return nil
	})
	framework.OnAfterGet(application, "notes", func(ctx context.Context, payload *hook.GetPayload) error {
		payload.Result["body"] = "masked"
		return nil
	})
	server := httptest.NewServer(application.Router())
	defer server.Close()
	factories := []struct {
		name  string
		build func(string) (client.NotesRepo, context.Context)
	}{
		{"Local", func(token string) (client.NotesRepo, context.Context) {
			return local.NewNotesLocal(application.InProcessHandler()), authenticate(context.Background(), token)
		}},
		{"Remote", func(token string) (client.NotesRepo, context.Context) {
			api := client.NewClient(server.URL+"/api", server.Client())
			api.Token = token
			return client.NewNotesRemote(api), context.Background()
		}},
	}
	for _, factory := range factories {
		t.Run(factory.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			repo, ctx := factory.build("alice")
			otherRepo, otherCtx := factory.build("bob")
			other, err := otherRepo.Create(otherCtx, client.NotesInput{Title: "other", Body: pointer("stored")})
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			defer otherRepo.Delete(otherCtx, other.ID)
			foreignRepo, foreignCtx := factory.build("alice-two")
			foreign, err := foreignRepo.Create(foreignCtx, client.NotesInput{Title: "foreign"})
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			defer foreignRepo.Delete(foreignCtx, foreign.ID)
			first, err := repo.Create(ctx, client.NotesInput{Title: "first", Body: pointer("stored"), Score: pointer(10)})
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			defer repo.Delete(ctx, first.ID)
			second, err := repo.Create(ctx, client.NotesInput{Title: "second", Score: pointer(20)})
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			defer repo.Delete(ctx, second.ID)
			blocked, err := repo.Create(ctx, client.NotesInput{Title: "blocked", Body: pointer("stored")})
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if first.Title != "first-created" || first.Body != "masked" {
				t.Fatalf("create hooks: %+v", first)
			}
			t.Run("OwnerScope", func(t *testing.T) {
				page, err := repo.List(ctx, nil)
				if err != nil || page.Total != 2 || len(page.Data) != 2 {
					t.Fatalf("list leaked or lost rows: %+v, %v", page, err)
				}
				_, err = repo.Get(ctx, other.ID)
				wantStatus(t, err, 404)
				_, err = repo.Update(ctx, other.ID, client.NotesInput{Title: "tampered"})
				wantStatus(t, err, 404)
				title := "tampered"
				_, err = repo.Patch(ctx, other.ID, client.NotesPatch{Title: &title})
				wantStatus(t, err, 404)
				wantStatus(t, repo.Delete(ctx, other.ID), 404)
			})
			t.Run("TenantScope", func(t *testing.T) {
				_, err := repo.Get(ctx, foreign.ID)
				wantStatus(t, err, 404)
				wantStatus(t, repo.Delete(ctx, foreign.ID), 404)
			})
			t.Run("ListOptions", func(t *testing.T) {
				page, err := repo.List(ctx, url.Values{"sort": {"-score"}, "page": {"2"}, "limit": {"1"}, "score_gte": {"10"}})
				if err != nil || page.Total != 2 || page.Page != 2 || page.PerPage != 1 || page.TotalPages != 2 || len(page.Data) != 1 || page.Data[0].ID != first.ID || page.Data[0].Body != "masked" {
					t.Fatalf("list options or read hooks: %+v, %v", page, err)
				}
			})
			t.Run("ReadHooks", func(t *testing.T) {
				row, err := repo.Get(ctx, first.ID)
				if err != nil || row.Body != "masked" {
					t.Fatalf("get hook: %+v, %v", row, err)
				}
				_, err = repo.Get(ctx, blocked.ID)
				wantStatus(t, err, 404)
				title := "escaped"
				_, err = repo.Patch(ctx, blocked.ID, client.NotesPatch{Title: &title})
				wantStatus(t, err, 404)
				wantStatus(t, repo.Delete(ctx, blocked.ID), 404)
			})
			t.Run("Access", func(t *testing.T) {
				for _, token := range []string{"", "denied"} {
					denied, deniedCtx := factory.build(token)
					_, err := denied.List(deniedCtx, nil)
					wantRefusal(t, err)
					_, err = denied.Get(deniedCtx, first.ID)
					wantRefusal(t, err)
					_, err = denied.Create(deniedCtx, client.NotesInput{Title: "denied"})
					wantRefusal(t, err)
					_, err = denied.Update(deniedCtx, first.ID, client.NotesInput{Title: "denied"})
					wantRefusal(t, err)
					title := "denied"
					_, err = denied.Patch(deniedCtx, first.ID, client.NotesPatch{Title: &title})
					wantRefusal(t, err)
					wantRefusal(t, denied.Delete(deniedCtx, first.ID))
				}
			})
			t.Run("Validation", func(t *testing.T) {
				_, err := repo.Create(ctx, client.NotesInput{})
				wantStatus(t, err, 400)
				empty := ""
				_, err = repo.Patch(ctx, first.ID, client.NotesPatch{Title: &empty})
				wantStatus(t, err, 400)
			})
			t.Run("Writes", func(t *testing.T) {
				row, err := repo.Update(ctx, first.ID, client.NotesInput{Title: "updated", Score: pointer(9)})
				if err != nil || row.Title != "updated" || row.Body != "masked" {
					t.Fatalf("update: %+v, %v", row, err)
				}
				zero := 0
				row, err = repo.Patch(ctx, first.ID, client.NotesPatch{Score: &zero})
				if err != nil || row.Score != 0 || row.Title != "updated" || row.Body != "masked" {
					t.Fatalf("patch: %+v, %v", row, err)
				}
				if err := repo.Delete(ctx, first.ID); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				_, err = repo.Get(ctx, first.ID)
				wantStatus(t, err, 404)
			})
			t.Run("Canceled", func(t *testing.T) {
				canceled, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
				cancel()
				_, err := repo.List(canceled, nil)
				if !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
					t.Fatalf("canceled list: %v", err)
				}
			})
		})
	}
	if created != 10 || updated != 4 || deleted != 8 {
		t.Fatalf("lifecycle counts: create=%d update=%d delete=%d", created, updated, deleted)
	}
	t.Run("LocalCookieRefused", func(t *testing.T) {
		repository := local.NewNotesLocal(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
			request.Header.Set("Cookie", "session=browser")
			application.InProcessHandler().ServeHTTP(writer, request)
		}))
		_, err := repository.Create(authenticate(context.Background(), "alice"), client.NotesInput{Title: "credential"})
		wantStatus(t, err, http.StatusForbidden)
	})
}

func TestLocalCanceledDuringDispatch(t *testing.T) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	defer cancel()
	repository := local.NewNotesLocal(http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		cancel()
		<-request.Context().Done()
	}))
	_, err := repository.List(ctx, nil)
	if !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
		t.Fatalf("canceled during dispatch: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestRepositoryKeyRoundTrips(t *testing.T) {
	database, err := sql.Open("sqlite3", ":memory:")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer database.Close()
	database.SetMaxOpenConns(1)
	for _, statement := range []string{
		`CREATE TABLE counters (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT)`,
		`CREATE TABLE memberships (repo TEXT, http TEXT, context TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (repo, http, context))`,
	} {
		if _, err := database.Exec(statement); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	application := framework.NewApp(framework.WithDB(database), framework.WithAPIPrefix("api"))
	application.Entity("counters", framework.EntityConfig{
		Fields:   []schema.Field{{Name: "id", Type: schema.Int, AutoGenerate: schema.AutoIncrement}},
		Exposure: &framework.ExposureConfig{CRUD: pointer(true), Public: true},
	}.WithTimestamps(false))
	application.Entity("memberships", framework.EntityConfig{
		PrimaryKey: []string{"repo", "http", "context"},
		Fields:     []schema.Field{{Name: "repo", Type: schema.String}, {Name: "http", Type: schema.String}, {Name: "context", Type: schema.String}},
		Exposure:   &framework.ExposureConfig{CRUD: pointer(true), Public: true},
	}.WithTimestamps(false))
	server := httptest.NewServer(application.Router())
	defer server.Close()
	remote := client.NewClient(server.URL+"/api", server.Client())
	for _, repositories := range []struct {
		name        string
		counters    client.CountersRepo
		memberships client.MembershipsRepo
	}{
		{"Local", local.NewCountersLocal(application.InProcessHandler()), local.NewMembershipsLocal(application.InProcessHandler())},
		{"Remote", client.NewCountersRemote(remote), client.NewMembershipsRemote(remote)},
	} {
		t.Run(repositories.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			ctx := context.Background()
			counter, err := repositories.counters.Create(ctx, client.CountersInput{})
			if err != nil || counter.ID <= 0 {
				t.Fatalf("create counter: %+v, %v", counter, err)
			}
			loaded, err := repositories.counters.Get(ctx, counter.ID)
			if err != nil || loaded.ID != counter.ID {
				t.Fatalf("get counter: %+v, %v", loaded, err)
			}
			if err := repositories.counters.Delete(ctx, counter.ID); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			_, err = repositories.counters.Get(ctx, counter.ID)
			wantStatus(t, err, http.StatusNotFound)
			membership, err := repositories.memberships.Create(ctx, client.MembershipsInput{Repo: pointer("repo one"), Http: pointer("https:"), Context: pointer("a+b")})
			if err != nil || membership.Repo != "repo one" || membership.Http != "https:" || membership.Context != "a+b" {
				t.Fatalf("create membership: %+v, %v", membership, err)
			}
			found, err := repositories.memberships.Get(ctx, membership.Repo, membership.Http, membership.Context)
			if err != nil || found != membership {
				t.Fatalf("get membership: %+v, %v", found, err)
			}
			if err := repositories.memberships.Delete(ctx, membership.Repo, membership.Http, membership.Context); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			_, err = repositories.memberships.Get(ctx, membership.Repo, membership.Http, membership.Context)
			wantStatus(t, err, http.StatusNotFound)
		})
	}
}

func wantStatus(t *testing.T, err error, status int) {
	t.Helper()
	var apiError *client.APIError
	if !errors.As(err, &apiError) || apiError.Status != status {
		t.Fatalf("error %v, want HTTP %d", err, status)
	}
}

func wantRefusal(t *testing.T, err error) {
	t.Helper()
	var apiError *client.APIError
	if !errors.As(err, &apiError) || (apiError.Status != 401 && apiError.Status != 403) {
		t.Fatalf("error %v, want access refusal", err)
	}
}
